description: Lists the sites Latchkey can sign in to with the owner's passwords from Apple's Passwords app: each site, the user name, and whether Latchkey also has its verification code. Never shows a password or a code. With site: only sign-ins for that site. To type one into a page of Claude's, use logins_fill.

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

site.description: Only sign-ins for this site, like github.com

name: logins_find
title: Find Saved Sign-ins
